However, the best choice depends on how your team handles customer requests.

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best suited for | Ease of use |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Freshdesk | General customer support | Easy |
| Help Scout | Email-based support | Very easy |
| Zoho Desk | Budget-conscious teams | Moderate |
| Zendesk | Complex support operations | Moderate |

- **2–5 support agents\:** Help Scout or Zoho Desk.
- **5–15 support agents\:** Freshdesk.
- **15+ agents with complex workflows\:** Zendesk.
- **Website chat and AI automation are priorities\:** Intercom.
